add_action('wp_head', function(){ ?>
<style>
:root{--nh-paper:#f4f0e8;--nh-ink:#171713;--nh-pine:#1f4d47;--nh-steel:#6f6a62;--nh-rule:#d4cec3}
html,body{background:var(--nh-paper)!important;color:var(--nh-ink)!important}
.nh{max-width:1160px;margin:0 auto;padding:42px 28px 84px}.nh h1{font:500 clamp(3.3rem,7vw,6.8rem)/.93 Outfit,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:.25em 0 .35em}.nh h2{font:460 clamp(2.1rem,4vw,3.6rem)/.98 Newsreader,Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin:.35em 0 .6em}.nh p{font:400 1.05rem/1.58 Outfit,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--nh-steel);max-width:680px}.nh-tag{font:600 .7rem/1 Outfit,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--nh-pine)}
.nh-hero{min-height:650px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(340px,500px);gap:25px;align-items:center}.nh-rule{border-top:1px solid var(--nh-rule);padding-top:18px;margin-top:44px;font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--nh-steel)}
.nh-section{border-top:1px solid var(--nh-rule);padding:78px 0}.nh-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.9fr) minmax(300px,1.1fr);gap:62px;align-items:center}.nh-list{border-top:1px solid var(--nh-rule)}.nh-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:7rem 1fr;gap:24px;padding:23px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--nh-rule)}.nh-item strong{font:600 .72rem/1 Outfit,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--nh-pine)}.nh-muted{font-size:.9rem!important;line-height:1.55!important}
.nh-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1px;background:var(--nh-rule);border:1px solid var(--nh-rule)}.nh-card{background:var(--nh-paper);padding:30px;min-height:300px}.nh-card:hover{background:var(--nh-pine);color:var(--nh-paper)}.nh-card:hover p{color:rgba(244,240,232,.82)}
.nh-holo-stage{--holo-size:clamp(150px,24vw,330px);position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;perspective:1100px;overflow:hidden}
.nh-xl{height:clamp(360px,52vw,540px);--holo-size:min(52vw,360px)}
.nh-lg{height:clamp(300px,40vw,410px);--holo-size:min(38vw,270px)}
.nh-md{height:clamp(260px,32vw,330px);--holo-size:min(30vw,220px)}
.nh-sm{height:clamp(180px,24vw,230px);--holo-size:min(24vw,150px)}
.nh-axis{position:absolute;width:1px;height:68%;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(31,77,71,.85),transparent);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(31,77,71,.2)}
.nh-object{width:var(--holo-size);height:var(--holo-size);position:relative;transform-style:preserve-3d;animation:nh-spin 13s linear infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(31,77,71,.2))}
.nh-ring{position:absolute;inset:10%;border:1px solid rgba(31,77,71,.78);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(31,77,71,.12);transform-style:preserve-3d}
.nh-r2{inset:23%;transform:rotateX(70deg)}
.nh-r3{inset:2%;transform:rotateY(70deg)}
.nh-core{position:absolute;inset:34%;border:1px solid rgba(31,77,71,.92);background:rgba(31,77,71,.04);box-shadow:0 0 44px rgba(31,77,71,.18),inset 0 0 22px rgba(31,77,71,.13);transform-style:preserve-3d}
.nh-scan{position:absolute;left:4%;right:4%;height:1px;top:28%;background:rgba(31,77,71,.86);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(31,77,71,.52);animation:nh-scan 3.2s ease-in-out infinite}
.nh-glitch{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.18;animation:nh-glitch 7.4s steps(1,end) infinite;pointer-events:none}
.nh-glitch:before,.nh-glitch:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:12%;right:12%;height:1px;background:rgba(31,77,71,.75)}
.nh-glitch:before{top:34%}.nh-glitch:after{top:67%}
.nh-floor{position:absolute;width:min(72%,260px);height:12%;border:1px solid rgba(31,77,71,.22);border-radius:50%;bottom:10%;transform:rotateX(70deg);box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(31,77,71,.1)}
/* DDD: orthogonal domain lattice */
.nh-holo--ddd .nh-ring{border-radius:10%;transform:rotateX(68deg) rotateZ(45deg)}
.nh-holo--ddd .nh-r2{transform:rotateY(70deg) rotateZ(45deg)}
.nh-holo--ddd .nh-r3{transform:rotateX(70deg)}
.nh-holo--ddd .nh-core{inset:31%;border-radius:3px;transform:rotateZ(45deg) translateZ(18px)}
.nh-holo--ddd .nh-core:before,.nh-holo--ddd .nh-core:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:16%;border:1px solid rgba(31,77,71,.55);transform:rotateZ(90deg)}
/* Backend: layered rectangular runtime */
.nh-holo--backend .nh-ring{border-radius:14%;inset:8%;transform:rotateX(72deg)}
.nh-holo--backend .nh-r2{inset:22%;transform:rotateY(68deg)}
.nh-holo--backend .nh-r3{inset:3%;transform:rotateX(88deg)}
.nh-holo--backend .nh-core{inset:28%;border-radius:10px;transform:translateZ(24px)}
.nh-holo--backend .nh-core:before,.nh-holo--backend .nh-core:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:16%;right:16%;height:1px;background:rgba(31,77,71,.55);box-shadow:0 11px 0 rgba(31,77,71,.34),0 -11px 0 rgba(31,77,71,.34)}
/* Resilience: intersecting orbit + stable core */
.nh-holo--resilience .nh-ring{border-style:dashed;inset:7%}
.nh-holo--resilience .nh-r2{inset:18%;transform:rotateY(72deg)}
.nh-holo--resilience .nh-r3{inset:1%;transform:rotateX(70deg) rotateY(26deg)}
.nh-holo--resilience .nh-core{inset:30%;border-radius:50%;animation:nh-pulse 3.6s ease-in-out infinite}
.nh-holo--resilience .nh-core:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:25%;border:1px solid rgba(31,77,71,.45);border-radius:50%}
/* Evidence: floating document / provenance plane */
.nh-holo--evidence .nh-ring{border-radius:4px;inset:6%;transform:rotateY(67deg)}
.nh-holo--evidence .nh-r2{inset:17%;transform:rotateX(76deg)}
.nh-holo--evidence .nh-r3{inset:2%;transform:rotateY(82deg) rotateZ(90deg)}
.nh-holo--evidence .nh-core{inset:25% 34%;border-radius:2px;transform:translateZ(28px) rotateY(-10deg)}
.nh-holo--evidence .nh-core:before{content:'';position:absolute;left:18%;right:18%;top:23%;height:1px;background:rgba(31,77,71,.58);box-shadow:0 13px 0 rgba(31,77,71,.38),0 26px 0 rgba(31,77,71,.26)}
.nh-holo--evidence .nh-core:after{content:'';position:absolute;right:0;top:0;border-left:12px solid transparent;border-bottom:12px solid rgba(31,77,71,.14)}
@keyframes nh-pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(31,77,71,.12),inset 0 0 18px rgba(31,77,71,.1)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 52px rgba(31,77,71,.24),inset 0 0 26px rgba(31,77,71,.16)}}
@keyframes nh-spin{to{transform:rotateY(360deg) rotateX(5deg)}}@keyframes nh-scan{0%,100%{top:24%;opacity:.22}50%{top:76%;opacity:.92}}@keyframes nh-glitch{0%,88%,100%{transform:none;opacity:.13}89%{transform:translateX(4px) skewX(7deg);opacity:.7}90%{transform:translateX(-3px);opacity:.3}}
.nh-actions{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:25px}.nh-actions a{min-height:48px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:0 20px;text-decoration:none}.nh-primary{background:var(--nh-pine);color:var(--nh-paper)}.nh-secondary{border:1px solid var(--nh-ink);color:var(--nh-ink)}
@media(max-width:900px){.nh-hero,.nh-split{grid-template-columns:1fr}.nh-hero{min-height:0}.nh-hero .nh-holo-stage{order:2}.nh-hero .nh-hero-copy{order:1}.nh-xl{height:clamp(300px,78vw,390px);--holo-size:min(68vw,300px)}.nh-section{padding:60px 0}}
@media(max-width:680px){.nh{padding:28px 20px 60px}.nh-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}.nh-item{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px}.nh-lg{--holo-size:min(62vw,235px)}.nh-md{--holo-size:min(56vw,195px)}.nh-sm{--holo-size:min(48vw,135px)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.nh-object,.nh-scan,.nh-glitch,.nh-core{animation:none}.nh-object{transform:rotateY(28deg) rotateX(5deg)}}
</style>
<?php });
